kind_of_thing.quote: Rapid transit, mass rapid transit (MRT) or rail rapid transit (RRT) and commonly referred to as metro, is a type of high-capacity public transport that is generally built in urban areas.

kind_of_made_thing.quote: Rapid transit systems are usually electric railways that, unlike buses or trams, operate on an exclusive right-of-way, which cannot be accessed by pedestrians or other vehicles.

where_it_travels.quote: Modern services on rapid transit systems are provided on designated lines between stations typically using electric multiple units on railway tracks.
